cars.specification_market: 1968 Australian HK Monaro GTS 327 production-road brochure reference. PDF indexes 3 and 5 (printed 6–7 and 10–11) and enlarged text regions visually read. Preserve advertised bhp, native cubic inches and brochure alternatives; no modern net/kW conversion. Rear axle choices 3.36:1 and 3.08:1 are not reduced to an assumed ratio. No historic Group Nc racing specification, 307 engine, later HT/HG engine or race result is a road technical field. Count the original HK/HT/HG road family once.
cars.summary: The original Monaro GTS 327 belongs as an Australian performance-coupe icon: its V8, close-ratio manual, limited-slip axle and supporting chassis equipment formed a purposeful road package with Bathurst-winning heritage. The State Library’s Holden collection history records the original coupe introduction and racing connection.

facts.title: Why this car belongs
facts.explanation: The original Monaro GTS 327 belongs as an Australian performance-coupe icon: its V8, close-ratio manual, limited-slip axle and supporting chassis equipment formed a purposeful road package with Bathurst-winning heritage. The State Library’s Holden collection history records the original coupe introduction and racing connection.

media.caption: HK Monaro GTS 327 photographed by Sicnag; source identifies Warwick Yellow. Representative original road coupe with GTS/327 markings and rally-style wheel appearance. The image does not authenticate chassis provenance, engine internals, exact axle ratio, tyre specification or original equipment.
